key.answer_key: The unmodified glass bubble filler has a smooth outer surface. Once GO is grown on it and then thermally reduced to rGO, the filler surface carries wrinkled sheet-like patches, and these patches are denser on the GB@rGO stage than on the GB@GO stage. This establishes that the glass bubble spheres end up carrying a wrinkled rGO sheet coating after thermal reduction.
